$about: Встроенный английский «Очага» (docs/I18N.md). Слева — русский текст по умолчанию: это ключ, его не меняйте. Справа — перевод.
Пустая строка "" — ещё не переведено: в интерфейсе останется русский текст.
{имя} — подстановка (число, имя, название): перенесите её в перевод как есть, порядок слов — любой. {{ и }} — просто фигурные скобки.
Разделы — файлы, где встречается строка («Общие» — в нескольких местах). На перевод не влияют: одинаковый текст переводится один раз.
Перевод виден там, где интерфейс уже подключён к переводу (t() в коде); остальные строки заработают, когда их компонент переведут на t(), — ключ останется тем же.
Посмотреть сразу: npm run dev — обновляется на лету; или скопируйте файл в папку языков («Настройки интерфейса» → «Язык» → «Папка языков») и нажмите «Обновить список».
Новые строки добавляет npm run i18n:extract (пустыми); уже переведённое он не трогает.

campaign/campaignRules.ts.Попадание оружием по цели само бросает и: A weapon hit on a target rolls and applies the damage automatically.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.При критическом попадании кости урона бр: On a critical hit, the damage dice are rolled twice.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.В бою двигаться можно только в свой ход: In combat you can move only on your own turn and no farther than your speed.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Союзники, идущие в очереди инициативы по: Allies that come one after another in the initiative order act at the same time (and so do consecutive enemies).
campaign/campaignRules.ts.В бою мастер переставляет фигуры и дейст: In combat the GM moves figures and acts with them out of turn, beyond their speed and beyond the turn’s actions (shoves, teleports, legendary actions, lair). Off — the GM also moves and acts by the rules.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Персонаж или НПС не может закончить движ: A character or an NPC cannot end its move in another creature’s square.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Сквозь клетку враждебного существа не пр: You cannot move through a hostile creature’s square unless it is at least two sizes larger or smaller than you; you can move through an ally’s or a neutral’s square.
You cannot hit a target beyond the range.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Действие, бонусное действие и реакция на: An action, a bonus action and a reaction per turn.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Стены и существа между атакующим и целью: Walls and creatures between the attacker and the target raise the target’s AC.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Уход из досягаемости врага без «Отхода»: Leaving an enemy’s reach without Disengage lets it make an attack with its reaction.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Достиг порога опыта — уровень и хиты рас: On reaching the XP threshold, level and hit points grow on their own (for NPCs; for heroes — if the level-up window is off).
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Следующий долгий отдых даёт пользу не ра: A long rest gives its benefits no sooner than 24 hours after the previous one by the campaign clock (a party rest moves the clock forward 8 hours by itself).
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Герой игрока поднимает уровень сам, выби: A player’s hero levels up on their own, choosing hit points (roll or average), an Ability Score Improvement or a feat, and new spells.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Каждая вторая диагональ стоит две клетки: Every second diagonal costs two squares (optional rule).
campaign/campaignRules.ts.«Гуманоид, которого вы видите», «зверь»,: “A humanoid you can see”, “a beast”, “has no effect on undead or constructs” — the spell cannot be cast on an unsuitable target.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Атакующий и союзник вплотную к цели с ра: The attacker and an ally adjacent to the target on opposite sides of it — the melee attack has advantage (optional rule).
campaign/campaignRules.ts.В конце хода героя босс сам тратит лучше: At the end of a hero’s turn the boss spends its best legendary attack action on someone within reach (it hits the one who just ended their turn, if it can). Movement and the rest are up to the GM.
campaign/campaignRules.ts.Герой уходит из досягаемости НПС без «От: A hero leaves an NPC’s reach without Disengage — the NPC strikes with its reaction using its best melee weapon, with no GM button. Player characters are asked, as before.

components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Для постоянного туннеля вставьте токен и: For a permanent tunnel, paste the token from the Cloudflare dashboard and click “Save and start”.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Игроки, вошедшие через туннель, потеряют: Players who joined through the tunnel will lose connection. Invitation links through this tunnel will stop working.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Активный туннель будет перезапущен. Игро: The active tunnel will restart. Players will lose connection for a few seconds; a quick tunnel may also get a new address.

components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Быстрый туннель получит новый адрес. Ста: The quick tunnel will get a new address. Old invitations may stop working, and connected players will have to sign in again.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Сервер станет доступен из интернета чере: The server will become reachable from the internet through your router. The app will turn on TLS and try to set up the port. Continue only if you know you are using a public IP.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Прямой адрес через белый IP перестанет р: The direct public IP address will stop working. Players connected this way will lose connection.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Порт должен быть целым числом от 1 до 65: The port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Любой человек, который узнает адрес серв: Anyone who learns the server address will be able to create an account without an invitation. For a normal game it is safer to keep sign-up by invitation.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.✔ У роутера белый IP — игроки из интерне: ✔ The router has a white IP — players from the internet will reach it if the port is forwarded.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.✖ Провайдер даёт адрес из 100.64.0.0/10: ✖ The provider gives an address from 100.64.0.0/10 (CGNAT): the router can’t be reached from outside. Port forwarding won’t help — you need a white IP from the provider or a Cloudflare tunnel.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.✖ Внешний адрес роутера — частный: перед: ✖ The router’s external address is private: there is another router in front of it (the provider’s modem) or the provider doesn’t give a white IP. Forwarding on this router won’t help — you need a white IP from the provider (or forwarding on the modem too) or a Cloudflare tunnel.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.◐ Адрес роутера и публичный адрес не сов: ◐ The router’s address and the public address don’t match: the provider is behind NAT or this computer’s traffic goes through a VPN/proxy. Ask your provider whether your IP is white.
components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.? Роутер не ответил по UPnP — белый ли I: ? The router didn’t respond over UPnP — it’s impossible to tell from here whether the IP is white. Compare the external address in the router settings with the public address below: if they match, the IP is white.

components/connection/NetworkModes.vue.Проверяю адрес и роутер…: Checking the address and the router…

components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Рецепт пока не соблюдён. Разлить смесь с: The recipe isn’t met yet. Pour the mixture with a side effect? The brewing will end.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Жар {heat} · эссенция ровно {essence} ·: Heat {heat} · essence exactly {essence} · stability at least {stability}
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Действия закончились. Разлейте смесь — р: No actions left. Pour the mixture — the result depends on its current properties.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Действия закончились, но ингредиенты не: No actions left, but no ingredients were added. Ask the GM to end the brewing and start again.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Никто: выдам вручную: No one: I’ll hand it out
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Безупречное зелье само попадёт в снаряже: A flawless potion goes straight into the hero’s equipment.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Мастер выбирает рецепт и начинает пригот: The GM picks a recipe and starts the brewing. The cauldron appears for everyone in the campaign.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.попасть в диапазон жара рецепта, набрать: hit the recipe’s heat range, reach exactly the essence it needs and at least the stability it lists. Then click “Pour”.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Начальные свойства: жар 2, эссенция 0, у: Starting properties: heat 2, essence 0, stability 3. There are two portions of each ingredient. Their effects are shown on the cards and apply at once.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Добавление ингредиента, подогрев, охлажд: Adding an ingredient, heating, cooling and stirring each use one shared action. Everyone works on one cauldron with no turns — agree on who clicks.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Жар выше 6 или устойчивость ниже 0 сразу: Heat above 6 or stability below 0 ruins the mixture at once. The mixture can’t get colder than 0 or more stable than 6. Essence can’t be removed: take care not to add too much.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Разлив не тратит действие. Если рецепт с: Pouring doesn’t use an action. If the recipe is met, the mixture comes out flawless. Otherwise it has a glowing sediment and a sharp smell. You can’t pour plain water with no ingredients.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Когда действия закончились, остаётся раз: When the actions run out, all that’s left is to pour the mixture. If no ingredients were added, the GM ends the brewing and starts again. Closing the window doesn’t stop the brewing; the GM can end it and start again.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.два корня мандрагоры и один уголь салама: two mandrake roots and one salamander coal give heat 4, essence 5 and stability 2 — a finished warming elixir in three actions. All that’s left is to pour.
components/minigames/AlchemyModal.vue.Ингредиенты здесь учебные: золото и хара: The ingredients here are for practice: the characters’ gold and ability scores do not change. If the GM chose who gets the potion, a flawless potion goes into that hero’s equipment. The GM decides what a flawed mixture does. The cauldron is kept in the campaign: closing the window or restarting the app does not reset it.

components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Улицы спящего города · весь отряд: Streets of the sleeping city · the whole party
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Ищу путь к убежищу…: Looking for the way to the hideout…
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Выберите маршрут вместе. После выбора се: Choose a route together. Once you choose, the server reveals the obstacle; you can’t change the road on this leg.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Обойти и перевести дух: Go around and catch your breath
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Неудача рывка или укрытия: путь +1, отры: A failed dash or hide: distance +1, lead −2. The energy for a dash is spent whatever the result.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Отряд начинает с отрывом 4 и запасом сил: The party starts with a lead of 4 and 3 energy. Cover 10 distance in 8 legs.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Мастер ещё не начал погоню. Когда он под: The GM hasn’t started the chase yet. Once the alarm is raised, the party sees the shared routes.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.набрать 10 пути за 8 участков и сохранит: cover 10 distance in 8 legs and keep the lead above zero. A lead of zero means the party is caught, even right at the hideout.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Главная улица даёт +1 пути при успехе, п: The main street gives +1 distance on a success, the alleys +2, the rooftops +3. The shorter the way, the harder the check. Choosing a road doesn’t use up a leg by itself.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Оно случайно выбирается сервером и облег: The server picks it at random, and it makes one of the approaches easier. The exact roll needed is shown on the button. You can’t go back to choosing a road.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.потратьте 1 силу и бросьте к6. Успех даё: spend 1 energy and roll a d6. A success moves you along the route and gives +2 lead.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.бросок без затрат сил, успех даёт продви: a roll that costs no energy; a success moves you along the route and gives +1 lead. Any failed roll gives only +1 distance and −2 lead.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.без броска получите +1 пути, −1 отрыва и: with no roll, get +1 distance and −1 lead and recover 1 energy (up to 4). This also ends the leg.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.После восьмого участка выходы перекрываю: After the eighth leg the exits are sealed. You can still win on the eighth leg if you already have 10 distance and a lead above zero.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.на крышах выпала телега. Для рывка нужно: on the rooftops the cart came up. A dash needs 4+ on a d6. A 5: distance +3, lead +2, energy −1. A 3: distance +1, lead −2, energy −1 all the same.
components/minigames/ChaseModal.vue.Отряд действует совместно, без очереди и: The party acts together, with no turn order and no timer. The server rolls the dice. This strength and route belong to the mini-game only: the characters’ ability scores, figure positions and combat actions do not change. The characters’ Athletics, Acrobatics and Stealth checks are not connected yet. The GM decides the consequences. The chase is kept in the campaign and survives an app restart.

components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Завершить общую партию без победителя?: End the shared game without a winner?
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Раз за партию можно незаметно убрать дра: Once a game you can quietly remove this turn’s dragon. If you are caught, the points at stake burn and the turn passes on.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Заберите добычу вовремя. Второй дракон с: Take your loot in time. The second dragon burns the turn’s points.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Вы за столом. Создатель начнёт партию, к: You are at the table. The creator will start the game once everyone has gathered.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.набрать больше сохранённых очков за три: bank more points over three rounds. A tie is a shared victory. Alone, you practise and try to beat your own score.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Нажмите «Собрать стол». Остальные открыв: Press “Set up the table”. The others open this game and press “Join”. The creator starts the game when everyone is ready. Nobody can join after the start.
Wait for your turn and roll the die.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.1 — дракон, без очков; 2, 3, 4 или 5 — с: 1 is a dragon, no points; 2, 3, 4 or 5 give that many points; 6 is a gem, 10 points at once. Points add up to the sum “at stake”.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.«Сохранить» прибавляет всю сумму на кону: “Bank” adds the whole sum at stake to your score and passes the turn. “Risk it again” rolls the die once more in the same turn.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Первый дракон не отнимает добычу, но ост: The first dragon takes no loot but stays until the end of the turn. A second dragon in the same turn, even not in a row, burns the whole sum at stake and passes the turn at once. Points banked earlier are not lost.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Круг заканчивается, когда сходили все. К: A round ends when everyone has played. Everyone gets exactly three turns. Each new turn starts with nothing at stake and no dragons.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.выпали 4, затем 6 — на кону 14. Выпала 1: you roll 4, then 6 — 14 at stake. A 1 comes up — the first dragon, still 14. You may bank 14. If you risk it and get another 1, those 14 burn; your earlier score stays.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Раз за партию, когда в вашем ходу выпал: Once a game, when the first dragon of your turn comes up, you can hide it with your hero’s Sleight of Hand check. The GM sets the DC, usually 13. On a success the dragon is gone and the turn goes on. On a failure you are caught: the points at stake burn and the turn passes on.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.До начала партии создатель может назначи: Before the game starts, the creator can set a stake. Each player agrees on their own and picks the hero whose purse pays; the game starts once everyone has agreed. The coins are taken at the start. The winner takes the pot; on a tie it is split evenly. If the game is ended without a winner, the stakes are returned.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.В одном ходу можно бросать несколько раз: You may roll several times in one turn. You can bank only after the first roll, even if it gave 0 points. The score next to a name is the points already banked.
components/minigames/DragonDiceModal.vue.Закрытие окна не выводит из партии и не: Closing the window does not take you out of the game or skip your turn. If a player disconnects, the creator or the GM can end the game without a winner. The game is kept in the campaign and survives an app restart. The characters’ gold and ability scores do not change.

components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Уступить победу сопернику?: Concede the win to your opponent?
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Завершить дуэль без победителя?: End the duel with no winner?
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Другой участник кампании может принять в: Another member of the campaign can accept the challenge.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Вы наблюдаете. Приёмы раскроются, когда: You are watching. The moves are revealed once both opponents have chosen.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Соперник его не видит. Изменить выбор не: Your opponent can’t see it. The choice can’t be changed — waiting for the reveal.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Выберите приём. Он сразу фиксируется; со: Choose a move. It is locked in at once; your opponent sees it only after choosing theirs.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Два участника кампании, по 6 стойкости и: Two campaign members, 6 resolve and 3 stamina each. Everyone else can watch.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Создатель бросает вызов, второй участник: The creator issues the challenge and a second member accepts it. The creator starts the duel. The game needs two different campaign members.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Каждый тайно выбирает один доступный при: Each duelist secretly picks one available move. The choice can’t be changed. Not even a watching GM sees the move before the reveal. Resolve and stamina update only after both decisions.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Урон наносится одновременно. В таблице —: Damage is dealt at the same time. The table shows the damage the row’s move deals to the column’s move. Damage lowers the opponent’s resolve.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.натиск против защиты наносит 0, а защита: a charge against protection deals 0, and protection answers the charge with 1 damage. The charge loses 1 stamina, protection recovers 1. A feint against protection deals 2 damage with no damage back.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Натиск стоит 1 выносливость, финт — 2. З: A charge costs 1 stamina, a feint 2. Protection recovers 1, waiting 2, up to 3. The cost is paid whatever the result. At zero stamina only protection and waiting are available.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Дуэль заканчивается при нулевой стойкост: The duel ends when someone’s resolve hits zero or after 8 rounds. Whoever has more resolve wins; a tie is a draw, including both falling at once. You can concede and give the win to your opponent.
components/minigames/DuelModal.vue.Создатель может назначить ставку до нача: The creator can set a stake before the start: each duellist agrees on their own and picks the hero whose purse pays. The winner takes both stakes; a draw or a cancelled duel returns them. There is no timer. Closing the window keeps your choice and does not mean giving up. If the opponent disconnects, the creator or the GM can cancel the duel. The duel is kept in the campaign and survives an app restart. The mini-game’s resolve and stamina do not change the characters’ hit points, resources or items.

All your heroes have already tried.

components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Показать верный путь и завершить поиск?: Show the right path and end the search?
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Удачная проверка открывает подсказку мас: A successful check opens the GM’s hint for the whole party. Each hero tries once.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Запишите, как вы сопоставили даты или на: Note how you matched the dates or found a contradiction.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Верный маршрут покажет всем тайный предм: The right route shows everyone a secret item on a scene. The list shows items with a detection DC.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Каждый герой отряда может один раз броси: Each hero in the party can roll this skill once: a success opens the hint.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Мастер ещё не разложил карту. Когда он в: The GM hasn’t laid out the map yet. Once a story is chosen, the fragments appear for the whole party.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.собрать маршрут из четырёх разных мест в: assemble a route of four different places in the right order. There are five places — one is extra.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Прочитайте все обрывки. Обращайте вниман: Read all the fragments. Watch the dates and events: an old source may describe a road that can no longer be used.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Нажимайте названия мест в порядке движен: Click the place names in the order of travel. “Remove” deletes the chosen stop and shifts the ones after it; new stops always go to the end. Changing the route is free.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Можно отметить сомнительный обрывок и до: You can mark a doubtful fragment and add a note. The whole party sees them. A mark is only your guess: it doesn’t change the right answer.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.«Проверить маршрут» расходует одну из че: “Check the route” uses one of four shared checks. The answer shows how many positions are right but not which. You can’t repeat a route that was already checked, and trying doesn’t use a check.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Четыре совпадения означают успех, в том: Four matches mean success, including on the last check. After four misses the route locks: the GM can give a hint, show the path based on how the scene went or start a new riddle.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.записка «после башни сразу мост» означае: a note saying “right after the tower comes the bridge” means these places are next to each other. If another fragment was written before the road was destroyed, its directions may be out of date.
components/minigames/MapFragmentsModal.v.Таймера и автоматических бросков нет. Со: There is no timer and no automatic rolls. The state is shared by the campaign; agree on who changes the route. If the GM set a skill check (History, Survival or Investigation), each hero can roll it once: a success opens the hint. If the GM tied the map to a secret item on a scene, the right route reveals it on the map to everyone. The mini-game does not change figures or rewards. The search is kept in the campaign: closing the window or restarting the app does not reset it.

components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Выберите занятие для отряда. Открытая па: Choose a pastime for the party. An open game is shared by the campaign’s members.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Собирайте сокровища и вовремя останавлив: Gather treasure and stop in time: the second dragon burns the turn’s loot.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Прочитайте подсказку и совместите три ру: Read the clue and line up three runes. The GM prepares the riddle, the party looks for the answer.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Переносите энергию между стихиями. Найди: Move energy between the elements. Find the balance before the circle fades.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Смешивайте ингредиенты, управляйте жаром: Mix ingredients, control the heat and pour the potion in time.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Выбирайте дороги, берегите силы и оторви: Pick your roads, save your energy and shake off the pursuer before the exits are sealed.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Выбирайте приёмы тайно, угадывайте намер: Pick moves in secret, read your opponent’s intentions and save your stamina.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Сравните старые записи, найдите противор: Compare old records, find the contradictions and restore the way to the goal.
components/minigames/MiniGamesModal.vue.Правила доступны внутри каждой игры. Пар: Each game has its rules inside. A game is kept in the campaign: closing the window or restarting the app does not reset it.

components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.День уступает место ночи, а за луной про: Day gives way to night, and after the moon a star awakens.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Открыть замок по решению мастера?: Open the lock by the GM’s decision?
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.На механизме нет надписи. Попросите маст: There is no inscription on the mechanism. Ask the GM to describe the clues in the scene.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Эта комбинация уже есть в истории. Измен: This combination is already in the history. Change the rings.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Повороты бесплатны. Проверка тратит одну: Turning is free. A check spends one attempt for the whole party.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Удачная проверка ставит выбранное кольцо: A successful check turns the chosen ring into place and fixes it. Each hero tries once.
. It is not sent to the players.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Если вы назначили проверку навыка, герои: If you set a skill check, the heroes roll it themselves. Otherwise, after a successful Arcana or tools check, you can reveal a ring here.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Чтобы повесить замок на дверь на сцене: To put a lock on the door on the scene
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Выберите решение слева направо и напишит: Choose the solution from left to right and write a clue for the party. Symbols may repeat.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Дверь, выбранную на карте: The door chosen on the map
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Замок сразу запрёт выбранное, а разгадан: The lock shuts what you choose at once and unlocks it when solved. The list shows items on scenes that open. Choose a door on the map: “Add a rune lock…” in its window.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Каждый герой отряда может один раз броси: Each hero in the party can roll this skill once: a success reveals the chosen ring.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Показать замок отряду: Show the lock to the party
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Мастер ещё не подготовил замок. Когда он: The GM has not prepared the lock yet. Once the puzzle is created, the rings appear for the whole party.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Изменить картинки текущего замка: Change the pictures of the current lock
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Сохранить символы для отряда: Save the symbols for the party
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.выставить три символа в правильном поряд: set three symbols in the right order from left to right. Each ring has six symbols; repeats are allowed. The GM may replace their pictures and names — the rules stay the same.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Замок общий для кампании: любой участник: The lock is shared by the campaign: any member can turn a ring. Agree on who sets the combination.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Повороты не расходуют проверки. Закреплё: Turns do not spend checks. A fixed ring — by the GM or by a successful skill check — is already in place and does not turn.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Тратится одна общая проверка. Ответ «2 /: One shared check is spent. The answer “2 / 3” means two right positions but does not say which. The history keeps every checked variant.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Если последняя проверка неверна, механиз: If the last check is wrong, the mechanism jams. Checking a combination again is not allowed and spends no attempt.
If you are stuck, ask the GM.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Он может раскрыть кольцо, открыть замок: They may reveal a ring, open the lock on a regular roll’s result or prepare a new riddle.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.решение — Солнце → Луна → Звезда. Провер: the solution is Sun → Moon → Star. Checking Sun → Leaf → Star gives “2 / 3”. Turning the middle ring to the Moon and checking again opens the lock.
components/minigames/RuneLockModal.vue.Таймера и автоматического урона нет. Есл: There is no timer and no automatic damage. If the GM put the lock on a door or a chest, it stays locked until the lock opens, and no lockpick works on it. The GM decides traps and rewards. The lock is kept in the campaign: closing the window or restarting the app does not reset it.

Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB.
components/minigames/RuneSymbolsEditor.v.Не удалось загрузить изображение. Попроб: Could not upload the image. Try again.
components/minigames/RuneSymbolsEditor.v.Замените любые из шести картинок и задай: Replace any of the six pictures and set the names. PNG, JPEG, WebP up to 2 MB. The whole party sees the images after saving.

components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Совместный ритуал · весь отряд: A joint ritual · the whole party
. Pass energy to the neighbours around the circle.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.· выберите объём и соседнюю печать: · choose the amount and a neighbouring seal
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Мастер ещё не начал ритуал. Все участник: The GM has not started the ritual yet. All members will see one shared circle.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.получить по 3 энергии во всех четырёх пе: get 3 energy into each of the four seals before the moves run out. There are always 12 energy in total.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Нажмите печать-источник, выберите 1 или: Press the source seal, choose 1 or 2 energy and the neighbour to the left or right around the circle. Nothing passes through the centre. One transfer spends one shared move.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.В печати может быть от 0 до 6 энергии. Е: A seal holds 0 to 6 energy. If a transfer would exceed 6, the energy stays in place, the move is spent and instability grows by 1. The third overload ends the ritual in failure.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.«Успокоить круг» снижает нестабильность: “Calm the circle” lowers instability by 1 and also spends a move. A source without enough energy cannot act, and no move is spent.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Все действуют совместно, без очереди. Об: Everyone acts together, without turns. Discuss the plan before pressing: the whole party has one supply of moves. Victory is possible on the very last move.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.у Пламени 5, у Прилива 1. Перенос 2 энер: Flame has 5, Tide has 1. Moving 2 energy from Flame to Tide gives both seals 3 and spends one move.
components/minigames/SealRitualModal.vue.Это отдельный игровой круг: позиции фигу: This is a separate game round: figure positions, combat actions, damage and rewards do not change on their own. The GM applies the scene’s consequences. The ritual is kept in the campaign: closing the window or restarting the app does not reset it.

components/minigames/WagerPanel.vue.Монеты спишутся из кошелька выбранного г: The coins are taken from the chosen hero’s purse when the game starts. The winner takes the pot; without a winner the stakes are returned. A new stake cancels the earlier agreements.
components/minigames/WagerPanel.vue.Вы ставите {priceText} из кошелька: You stake {priceText} from the purse of

Close the window? What you entered will not be saved.
components/objects/CreateObjectModal.vue.Не удалось создать объект. Попробуйте ещ: Could not create the object. Try again.

packages/domain/character/character-buil.Своя раса: выберите характеристику для +: Custom race: choose an ability for +2 and another for +1.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Выберите {flexibleBonuses} разные характ: Choose {flexibleBonuses} different abilities for +1 (other than Charisma).
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Навыки класса: выберите {count} из списк: Class skills: choose {count} from the class list.
The race gives no skills to choose.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Навык не выбирают дважды: уже данный рас: A skill isn’t chosen twice: replace one already given by race or background with another.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Компетентность: {expertise} навыка из те: Expertise: {expertise} skills you are proficient in.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Компетентность у этого класса на 1-м уро: This class doesn’t choose Expertise at level 1.
The class isn’t proficient with this armor.
The class isn’t proficient with shields.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Заговоры: {cantrips} разных из списка кл: Cantrips: {cantrips} different ones from the class list.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Этот класс не знает заговоров на 1-м уро: This class knows no cantrips at level 1.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Заклинания 1-го круга: {spellCount} разн: 1st-level spells: {spellCount} different ones from the class list{value}.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Этот класс не знает заклинаний на 1-м ур: This class knows no spells at level 1.
packages/domain/character/character-buil.Высший эльф: выберите заговор волшебника: High elf: choose a wizard cantrip.

packages/domain/character/class-features.Легендарных действий за раунд — от 0 до: Legendary actions per round — from 0 to 5.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Легендарного сопротивления в день — от 0: Legendary resistance per day — from 0 to 5.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вариантов легендарных действий — не боль: No more than 10 legendary action options.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Добавьте хотя бы один вариант легендарно: Add at least one legendary action option.
packages/domain/character/class-features.«{label}» стоит {cost}, а за раунд всего: “{label}” costs {cost}, but there are only {legendaryActions} per round.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Фаза «{label}»: порог — от 1 до 99 % хит: Phase “{label}”: the threshold is from 1 to 99% HP.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Перемещается на половину скорости, не пр: Moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Two weapon attacks in a row.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Босс ранен и приходит в ярость: держитес: The boss is wounded and flies into a rage: hold on!

packages/domain/character/class-features.Бонусным действием на минуту (10 раундов: As a bonus action for a minute (10 rounds): a bonus to Strength melee weapon damage, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, advantage on Strength checks and saving throws. You can’t cast spells or concentrate while raging. It ends early if your turn ends and you haven’t attacked or taken damage since your last turn.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бонусным действием восстановить 1d10 + у: As a bonus action, regain 1d10 + your fighter level HP. Once per short rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В свой ход — ещё одно действие. Раз до к: On your turn — one more action. Once per short rest (twice from level 17, but no more than once per turn).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Рывок, Отход или «Спрятаться» бонусным д: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Раз в ход — дополнительные кости урона а: Once per turn — extra damage dice on an attack with a finesse or ranged weapon with advantage. Without advantage — if an ally who isn’t incapacitated is within 5 feet of the target and you don’t have disadvantage.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попав рукопашным оружием, можно потратит: On a melee weapon hit you can spend a slot: 2d8 radiant damage for a 1st-level slot and 1d8 for each level higher (no more than 5d8); 1d8 more against undead and fiends.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бонусным действием — кость вдохновения с: As a bonus action — an inspiration die to a creature within 60 feet other than yourself (d6; d8 from level 5, d10 from 10, d12 from 15). Within 10 minutes it can add it to one ability check, attack roll or saving throw. One die per creature.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием: каждая нежить в 30 футах — сп: As an action: each undead within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC; on a failure it is turned for a minute (flees, no reactions; damage ends it). From level 5 weak undead are destroyed outright (CR 1/2; 1 from level 8, 2 from 11, 3 from 14, 4 from 17).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием на минуту: к броскам атаки ору: As an action for a minute: add your Charisma modifier (at least +1) to weapon attack rolls.
packages/domain/character/class-features.После действия «Атака» — за 1 очко ци бо: After the Attack action — for 1 ki point, two unarmed strikes as a bonus action (martial arts die: d4, d6 from level 5, d8 from 11, d10 from 17).
packages/domain/character/class-features.За 1 очко ци бонусным действием — «Уклон: For 1 ki point — Dodge as a bonus action.
packages/domain/character/class-features.За 1 очко ци бонусным действием — «Отход: For 1 ki point — Disengage or Dash as a bonus action.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Атаки оружием — крит на 19–20 (с 15-го у: Weapon attacks crit on 19–20 (from level 15, Superior Critical: 18–20).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попал атакующий, которого вы видите, — р: When an attacker you can see hits you — as a reaction, halve that attack’s damage. “Ready” — automatic, without asking.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Спасбросок Ловкости против эффекта «поло: A Dexterity save against a “half damage on success” effect: success — no damage, failure — half. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Отметьте выбранные: «Мучительный взрыв»: Mark the chosen ones: Agonizing Blast adds your Charisma modifier to each Eldritch Blast beam’s damage; Repelling Blast pushes the target 10 feet on a hit.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попадание дальнобойным оружием — реакцие: When hit by a ranged weapon — as a reaction, reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity + monk level. “Ready” — automatic, without asking.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попав рукопашной атакой, за 1 очко ци: ц: On a melee hit, for 1 ki point: the target makes a Constitution save against your ki DC (8 + proficiency + Wisdom); on a failure it is stunned until the end of your next turn.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием, касанием — вернуть хиты из за: As an action, by touch — restore HP from the pool (5 × paladin level per long rest), or spend 5 from it to cure a disease or poison. Doesn’t work on undead or constructs.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — облик зверя из бестиария (оп: As an action — the form of a bestiary beast (CR up to 1/4, no flying or swimming; up to 1/2 from level 4, up to 1 from 8): its HP, AC, speed, Strength, Dexterity, Constitution and attacks; at 0 beast HP you revert, and excess damage carries over. No spellcasting. Twice per short rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Перед первой атакой своего хода: рукопаш: Before the first attack on your turn: Strength melee attacks this turn have advantage, and attacks against you have advantage until the start of your next turn.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Спасброски Ловкости — с преимуществом (л: Dexterity saves have advantage (traps, spells, breath) if you aren’t blinded, deafened or incapacitated. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вы и союзники в 10 футах (с 18-го уровня: You and allies within 10 feet (30 from level 18) add your Charisma modifier (at least +1) to all saving throws while you aren’t incapacitated. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Отметьте выбранные; в окне сотворения —: Mark the chosen ones; in the casting window — Quickened Spell (2 points: an action spell as a bonus action) or Twinned Spell (points equal to the slot level, 1 for a cantrip: a single-target spell targets a second creature).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вне боя, раз до долгого отдыха (лучше —: Out of combat, once per long rest (ideally after a short one): regain spent slots with total levels up to half your wizard level (rounded up), none higher than 5th.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Заклинание 1-го уровня и выше, восстанав: A 1st-level or higher spell that restores HP heals each target an extra 2 + the slot level. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием: 5 × уровень жреца хитов подел: As an action: split 5 × cleric level HP among creatures within 30 feet — none above half its maximum. Not undead or constructs.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Отметьте приёмы; попав оружием — кнопка: Mark maneuvers; on a weapon hit — a maneuver button: a superiority die (d8; d10 from level 10, d12 from 18) to damage plus an effect — Trip Attack (knock prone), Pushing Attack (15 ft.), Menacing Attack (frighten), Distracting Strike (the next attack by someone else has advantage). The save is against DC 8 + proficiency + STR or DEX. Dice return on a short rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите: «Убийца колоссов» — раз в ход: Choose: Colossus Slayer — once per turn +1d8 weapon damage against a creature below its HP maximum (automatic); Giant Killer and Horde Breaker — manual.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Своё заклинание воплощения по области: с: Your evocation area spell: allies caught in it (up to 1 + the spell’s level) automatically succeed on the save, and where success means half damage, they take none. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Опустили хиты враждебного существа до 0: Reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP — gain temporary HP: CHA + warlock level (at least 1). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Заклинание с уроном вида вашего предка —: A spell dealing your ancestry’s damage type — +CHA to one of its damage rolls. The ancestry comes from character creation or is chosen here.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Существо, которое вы видите в 60 футах,: When a creature you can see within 60 feet attacks — as a reaction, subtract an inspiration die from the roll. “Ready” — automatic: only when it could turn a hit on an ally into a miss.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попав ударом «Шквала ударов» — на выбор:: On a Flurry of Blows hit — your choice: a DEX save or be knocked prone; a STR save or be pushed 15 ft.; or no reactions until the end of your next turn. The DC is your ki DC.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Впадая в ярость — можно в бешенство: в к: When you rage you can frenzy: on each later turn of the rage — one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. When the rage ends — a level of exhaustion.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием: каждое исчадие и нежить в 30: As an action: each fiend and undead within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC; on a failure they are turned for a minute (flee, no reactions; damage ends it).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Круг Земли: Природное восстановление: Circle of the Land: Natural Recovery
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вне боя, раз до долгого отдыха (лучше —: Out of combat, once per long rest (ideally after a short one): regain spent slots with total levels up to half your druid level (rounded up), none higher than 5th.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Лечите заклинанием 1-го уровня и выше др: Heal someone else with a 1st-level or higher spell — you regain 2 + the slot level HP. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.К одному броску урона вашего заклинания: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of your evocation spell. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В ярости вас нельзя очаровать или испуга: While raging you can’t be charmed or frightened; charm and fear from before the rage are suspended until it ends. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вас и союзников в 10 футах (с 18-го уров: You and allies within 10 feet (30 from level 18) can’t be charmed while you aren’t incapacitated. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием восстановить хиты: 3 × уровень: As an action, regain HP: 3 × monk level. Once per long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Проверка характеристики или спасбросок п: An ability check or saving throw against a DC fails and a d10 could save it — the die is added automatically. Once per short rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Раз в свой ход, попав атакой оружием, —: Once on your turn, on a weapon hit — 1d8 extra radiant damage (2d8 from level 14). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вас и союзников в 10 футах (с 18-го уров: You and allies within 10 feet (30 from level 18) can’t be frightened while you aren’t incapacitated. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Каждое попадание рукопашным оружием — ещ: Every melee weapon hit deals 1d8 extra radiant damage (2d8 on a crit). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Критическое попадание рукопашным оружием: A melee weapon critical hit — one extra weapon damage die (two from level 13, three from 17). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В ярости хиты упали до 0, но не убит сра: Dropping to 0 HP while raging without dying outright — a Constitution save DC 10 (+5 each later time before a rest): success — 1 HP. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Проверка навыка, которым вы владеете: к2: A check with a skill you are proficient in: a d20 below 10 counts as 10. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — закончить на себе очарование: As an action — end a charm or fear effect on yourself.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Иммунитет к болезням и яду: урон ядом не: Immune to disease and poison: no poison damage, “poisoned” can’t be applied. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Без доспеха и щита скорость больше на 10: Without armor or a shield, speed is 10 feet higher (15 from level 6, 20 from 10, 25 from 14, 30 from 18). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Владение всеми спасбросками; проваленный: Proficiency in all saving throws; reroll a failed save for 1 ki (the new result must be used). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Без тяжёлого доспеха скорость больше на: Without heavy armor, speed is 10 feet higher. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Проверка Силы ниже значения Силы — вмест: A Strength check below your Strength score uses the score instead. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Проваленный спасбросок — переброс (новый: Reroll a failed save (the new result must be used); once per long rest, twice from level 13, three times from 17. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.К проверкам Силы, Ловкости и Телосложени: Add half your proficiency, rounded up, to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks you aren’t proficient in (and to initiative). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В начале своего хода: хитов не больше по: At the start of your turn: at half HP or less but not 0 — regain 5 + Constitution HP. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.К проверкам характеристик без владения (: Add half your proficiency, rounded down, to ability checks you aren’t proficient in (and to initiative and passive Perception). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Короткий отдых: кто потратил кости хитов: Short rest: whoever spends Hit Dice regains an extra d6 HP (d8 from level 9, d10 from 13, d12 from 17) if the bard is conscious. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.У атак по вам нет преимущества, пока вы: Attacks against you don’t have advantage while you aren’t incapacitated. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.«Спрятаться» — бонусным действием (в «Де: Hide as a bonus action (in Actions); you can’t be tracked by magic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Атаки по тем, кого не видите (невидим, с: Attacks against creatures you can’t see (invisible, hidden, you are blinded) have no disadvantage. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Заклинание 6-го уровня (с 13-го — и 7-го: A 6th-level spell (plus 7th from level 13, 8th from 15, 9th from 17) — without a slot, each level once per long rest: a tick in the casting window.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выбранные заклинания 1-го и 2-го уровня: The chosen 1st- and 2nd-level spells — at their own level without a slot, at will: choose here, a tick in the casting window.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Два выбранных заклинания 3-го уровня — к: Two chosen 3rd-level spells — each once per short rest without a slot: choose here, a tick in the casting window.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Короткий отдых возвращает 4 очка чародей: A short rest restores 4 sorcery points. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Минута маскировки (вне боя): +10 к Скрыт: A minute of camouflage (out of combat): +10 to Stealth while you stand still and do nothing — a step, an attack or a spell ends it.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Пока слышите — знаете, где спрятавшиеся: While you can hear, you know where hidden creatures within 10 feet are: attacks against them lose the “target hidden” disadvantage (invisibility still gives disadvantage). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В облике зверя можно сотворять заклинани: You can cast spells in beast form (without costly material components). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Промах по цели — попадание: галочка в ок: A miss becomes a hit: a tick in the attack window, spent only on a miss. Once per short rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — воззвать к божеству: к100 не: As an action — call on your deity: a d100 no higher than your cleric level (always from level 20) and the deity intervenes (the GM decides); after a success — again in 7 days, after a failure — after a long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — закончить одно заклинание на: As an action — end one spell on yourself or an ally nearby (harmful ones first). Charisma times per long rest (at least 1).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бросая инициативу без единой кости вдохн: Rolling initiative with no inspiration dice left, you regain one. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бросая инициативу без единого очка ци, в: Rolling initiative with no ki points left, you regain 4. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Минуту взывая к покровителю, вернуть все: Spending a minute entreating your patron, regain all spent pact slots. Out of combat, once per long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Ярость кончается раньше срока, только ес: Your rage ends early only if you fall unconscious or end it yourself. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Сила и Телосложение +4, предел — 24. Сам: Strength and Constitution +4, maximum 24. Automatic on reaching level 20.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Без доспехов КД = 13 + Ловкость (щит мож: Without armor AC = 13 + Dexterity (a shield is allowed); +1 HP maximum per sorcerer level. Automatic: in the creation wizard and on level-up.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Цель преуспела в спасброске от вашего за: A target that succeeds on the save against your cantrip still takes half its damage but no other effects. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Заклинание 1–5 уровня с уроном — урон на: A damaging spell of levels 1–5 deals maximum damage (a tick in the casting window). The first time per long rest is free; after that — 2d12 necrotic damage per spell level at once, +1d12 per level for each further time; resistance and immunity don’t help.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Вне боя (после отдыха) выберите вид урон: Out of combat (after a rest) choose a damage type — resistance to it until you choose another. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from magical or silvered weapons ignores it — the GM decides this.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Кости лечения ваших заклинаний не бросаю: Your healing spell dice aren’t rolled — each gives its maximum. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите одно: «Уйти от толпы» — атаки п: Choose one: Escape the Horde — opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage; Multiattack Defense — when a creature hits you, its later attacks against you this turn are against AC +4; Steel Will — advantage on saves against being frightened.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите одно: «Залп» — действием дально: Choose one: Volley — as an action, a ranged attack against every creature within 10 feet of a point; Whirlwind Attack — as an action, a melee attack against every creature within 5 feet of you. Each target gets its own attack roll.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Падая, реакцией уменьшить урон от падени: When falling, as a reaction reduce the falling damage by 5 × monk level. Automatic (in combat — if your reaction is free).
packages/domain/character/class-features.Получив урон от существа в 5 футах, реак: When a creature within 5 feet damages you — as a reaction, a melee weapon attack against it. “Ready” — automatic, with your best melee weapon, if your reaction is free.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите одно: «Увёртливость» — спасброс: Choose one: Evasion — a “half on success” Dexterity save: success — no damage, failure — half; Stand Against the Tide — when an enemy misses you with a melee attack, as a reaction you force it to repeat the attack against another creature next to it (your enemy); Uncanny Dodge — when an attacker you can see hits you, as a reaction halve the damage. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием, 4 очка ци: на минуту — невиди: As an action, 4 ki points: for a minute — invisibility and resistance to all damage except force.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попав безоружным ударом, за 3 очка ци —: On an unarmed strike hit, for 3 ki points — deadly vibrations in the target’s body (for as many days as your monk levels; one target at a time). You can end them as an action: the target makes a Constitution save against your ki DC; failure — 0 HP, success — 10d10 necrotic damage.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Попав атакой по существу, можно мгновенн: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can instantly hurl it through the lower planes: until the end of your next turn it is gone from the battlefield (incapacitated, unseen); on returning it takes 10d10 psychic damage unless it is a fiend. Once per long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием на минуту: вас окружает яркий: As an action for a minute: bright light surrounds you for 30 feet (and dim light 30 more); an enemy starting its turn in the bright light takes 10 radiant damage; saves against spells of fiends and undead have advantage. Once per long rest.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Круг Земли: Поступь по земле: Circle of the Land: Land’s Stride
packages/domain/character/class-features.Немагическая труднопроходимая местность: Nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement. Automatic: the scene’s terrain squares count as normal.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бонусным действием — драконьи крылья: ск: As a bonus action — dragon wings: a flying speed equal to your walking speed until you fold them (also a bonus action). A flyer isn’t hindered by terrain or pit traps.
packages/domain/character/class-features.К своей проверке характеристики (и навык: You can add a Bardic Inspiration die to your own ability (and skill) check — one inspiration is spent. A tick in Checks.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Действием — до конца вашего следующего х: As an action — until the end of your next turn you and allies within 30 feet make saves against fear and charm with advantage.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Бонусным действием: ячейка — в очки чаро: As a bonus action: a slot into sorcery points (as many as its level), or points into a slot up to 5th level (1st — 2 points, 2nd — 3, 3rd — 5, 4th — 6, 5th — 7).
packages/domain/character/class-features.«Дикий облик» — сколько угодно раз. Само: Wild Shape — any number of times. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Проверка Скрытности — с преимуществом, е: Stealth checks have advantage if you moved no more than half your speed this turn. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.В первом раунде боя — два хода: на свою: In the first round of combat — two turns: at your initiative and at it −10 (a second entry in the order “…: thief’s reflexes”). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.После долгого отдыха вы под «Убежищем» (: After a long rest you are under Sanctuary (DC 8 + Wisdom + proficiency) until the next long rest; attacking or harming with a spell ends it. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Выберите тип существ (ещё один с 6-го и: Choose a creature type (one more at levels 6 and 14): with Foe Slayer at level 20 — a damage bonus against them. Advantage on Survival and Intelligence about them — the GM decides.
packages/domain/character/class-features.Раз в ход попав по избранному врагу — к: Once per turn when you hit a favored enemy — add your Wisdom modifier to damage. Automatic.

packages/domain/character/class-features.Зверь или растение, атакующее вас, снача: A beast or plant attacking you first makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC; on a failure the attack doesn’t happen. Automatic.

packages/domain/character/class-features.Без доспехов и щита КД = 10 + Ловкость +: Without armor or a shield AC = 10 + Dexterity + Wisdom. When multiclassing it isn’t taken twice.

packages/domain/character/feats.ts.+5 к инициативе; атаки по вам не получаю: +5 to initiative; attacks against you don’t gain advantage from you not seeing the attacker. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Спасброски Телосложения для концентрации: Advantage on Constitution saves to keep concentration. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Дальнобойным оружием: дальняя дистанция: With ranged weapons: no disadvantage at long range, half and ¾ cover don’t hinder — automatic; −5 to hit / +10 damage — a tick in the attack window.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Тяжёлым рукопашным оружием: −5 к попадан: With a heavy melee weapon: −5 to hit / +10 damage — a tick in the attack window.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Скорость +10 футов; по кому били в рукоп: Speed +10 feet; a creature you made a melee attack against this turn doesn’t get an opportunity attack on you. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.3 очка удачи до долгого отдыха: провален: 3 luck points per long rest: a failed save rolled by the server gets another d20 and the better is used (the “Reroll a failed save” rule); in the attack window — the tick “on a miss, spend a luck point”; for a check — a tick in Checks; against attacks on you — “ready” here (on a hit another d20, and the lower is used).
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Атака при уходе попала — скорость цели 0: An opportunity attack hits — the target’s speed is 0 until the end of its turn; Disengage doesn’t protect from your opportunity attacks; an adjacent enemy attacks someone else — attack it as a reaction (a prompt; NPCs do it themselves). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Враг в 5 футах не даёт помехи вашим даль: An enemy within 5 feet doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks (weapon and spell); a bonus hand crossbow shot adds the modifier to damage. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Заклинания с броском атаки — дальность в: Spells with an attack roll — double range, half and ¾ cover don’t hinder. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Раз в свой ход: кости урона рукопашным о: Once on your turn: melee weapon damage dice are rolled twice and the higher result is used. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Урон дробящий, колющий и рубящий — на 3: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage is reduced by 3 (heavy armor is assumed worn). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Вне боя, речь 10 минут: до 6 своих в 30: Out of combat, a 10-minute speech: up to 6 allies within 30 feet (and you) gain temporary HP equal to level + Charisma; once per short rest.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Глефа, алебарда, пика, боевой посох, коп: Glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, spear: a bonus butt-end attack — 1d4 bludgeoning (a bonus-action attack with this weapon); an enemy entering your reach provokes an opportunity attack. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.«Толкнуть» — и бонусным действием (в «Де: Shove — also as a bonus action (in Actions). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Ритуалы — как у волшебника: «ритуалом» в: Rituals like a wizard: “as a ritual” in the casting window, no slot, +10 minutes. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Спасброски против заклинаний того, кто в: Advantage on saves against spells of a creature within 5 feet of you; casting nearby — attack it as a reaction (a prompt; NPCs do it themselves); your damage gives disadvantage on its concentration save. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Ваши заклинания с уроном вида «{ru}»: со: Your spells dealing “{ru}” damage: resistance to it doesn’t help, and 1s on damage dice count as 2s. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Кость хитов на коротком отдыхе даёт не м: A Hit Die on a short rest gives at least twice your Constitution modifier (at least 2). Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feats.ts.Максимум хитов +2 за уровень: взята при: HP maximum +2 per level: taken at level-up — +2 × level at once, then +2 for each level. Automatic.

packages/domain/character/feature-texts..+2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум: +2 to one ability or +1 to two (20 at most), or a feat instead. Choose on the “Improvement” step.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Особая сила божества: «Изгнание нежити»: Your deity’s power: Turn Undead and your domain’s option. It comes back after a short rest; twice from level 6, three times from level 18.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Нежить, проигравшая спасбросок от «Изгна: Undead that fail the save against Turn Undead are destroyed at once if their challenge rating is no higher than shown.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Кость безоружного удара и оружия монаха: The die for unarmed strikes and monk weapons grows: d6 from level 5, d8 from 11, d10 from 17.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Действием «Атака» — две атаки вместо одн: The Attack action makes two attacks instead of one.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Бонус мастерства удваивается в проверках: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with two chosen skills. Choose on the “Expertise” step.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Своя манера боя на выбор — на шаге «Боев: A fighting style of your choice on the “Fighting Style” step. The game adds the attack, damage or AC bonus itself.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Начинается колдовство: ячейки 1-го круга: Spellcasting begins: level 1 slots that grow with your level. A paladin prepares spells each day, a ranger knows the ones chosen.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Три навыка на выбор — отметьте владение: Three skills of your choice: mark the proficiencies on the sheet yourself. Cutting Words: as a reaction, a Bardic Inspiration die is subtracted from an enemy’s roll within 60 feet. The game applies this.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Кости вдохновения барда возвращаются и п: Bardic Inspiration dice come back after a short rest too, not only after a long one.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Два заклинания из списка любого класса,: Two spells from any class’s list, up to the level you can cast. Choose on the “Spells” step.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Ещё два заклинания из списка любого клас: Two more spells from any class’s list; they count as bard spells. Choose on the “Spells” step.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Просьба о божественном вмешательстве исп: A call for divine intervention always succeeds, with no d100 roll.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Ещё один заговор друида — впишите его в: One more druid cantrip: add it to the sheet. Natural Recovery: on a short rest, recover slots totalling up to half your druid level. The game applies this.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..По выбранной местности — арктика, горы,: Depending on the chosen land (arctic, mountain, forest and others), the druid gains circle spells that are always prepared. Add them on the “Magic” tab.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Облик сильнее: с 4-го уровня — звери до: Stronger forms: from level 4, beasts up to challenge 1/2 and swimmers; from level 8, up to challenge 1 and flyers.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Друид стареет в десять раз медленнее обы: The druid ages ten times more slowly than normal.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Ещё один боевой стиль из тех, которых у: One more fighting style the hero does not have yet. Choose on the “Fighting Style” step.
The Attack action makes three attacks.
The Attack action makes four attacks.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Очки ци по уровню монаха, возвращаются п: Ki points equal to your monk level, back after a short rest. They fuel Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind and other techniques.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..За 1 ци бонусным действием: два безоружн: For 1 ki as a bonus action: two unarmed strikes after an attack, Dodge, or Dash or Disengage with a jump twice as far.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Безоружные удары монаха считаются магиче: The monk’s unarmed strikes count as magical against resistances and immunities. The table does not tell them apart, so track it yourself.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..В свой ход монах бежит по отвесным стена: On their turn the monk runs along vertical walls and across water without falling while moving.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Монах понимает любой язык, а его самого: The monk understands every language, and any creature that knows a language understands the monk.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Монах не дряхлеет от старости, может обх: The monk suffers no frailty of old age, needs no food or water, and cannot be aged by magic.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Паладин не болеет: болезни на него не ло: The paladin is immune to disease: diseases don’t take hold. Automatic.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Заклинания клятвы всегда подготовлены —: Oath spells are always prepared: add them on the “Magic” tab. Channel Divinity: the game applies Sacred Weapon and Turn the Unholy itself.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Ауры паладина действуют в 30 футах вмест: The paladin’s auras reach 30 feet instead of 10.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Потратив ячейку, следопыт на несколько м: By spending a slot, the ranger senses for a few minutes whether aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends or undead are near (within a mile, six in favored terrain). The GM gives the answer.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Ещё один избранный тип врагов — отметьте: One more favored enemy type: mark it under “Features” and the game applies it. One more favored terrain, as agreed with the GM.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Ещё одна любимая местность: в ней отряд: One more favored terrain: there the group does not get lost, and the ranger finds more food and notices dangers. The GM keeps track.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Бонусным действием — Ловкость рук, вскры: As a bonus action: Sleight of Hand, picking a lock, disarming a trap or Use an Object. Climbing costs no extra movement, and running jumps go farther. The table does not track this, so keep it in mind yourself.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Плут пользуется любыми магическими предм: The rogue can use any magic item, ignoring class, race and level requirements.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Очки чародейства по уровню, возвращаются: Sorcery points equal to your level, back after a long rest. As a bonus action, points become slots and slots become points.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Дар покровителя на выбор: договор клинка: Your patron’s gift: Pact of the Blade (a weapon from thin air), of the Chain (a special familiar) or of the Tome (a book with three cantrips from any class). Write the choice on the sheet: the game does not apply it.
packages/domain/character/feature-texts..Заклинания воплощения переписываются в к: Copying evocation spells into your book takes half the time and gold. Sculpt Spells: allies in your evocation’s area succeed on their saves and take no damage. The game applies this.

The shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The shield remains animated for 1 minute, until you use a bonus action to end this effect, or until you are incapacitated or die, at which point the shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free.

You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

You have resistance to nonmagical damage while you wear this armor. Additionally, you can use an action to make yourself immune to nonmagical damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this special action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

d10 — Damage Type

While wearing this armor, you have resistance to  one of the following damage types: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly.
Curse. This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when an identify spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by the remove curse spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed, you have vulnerability to two of the three damage types associated with the armor (not the one to which it grants resistance).

This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC. In addition, whenever an attacker makes a ranged attack against a target within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to become the target of the attack instead.
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/armor.ts.Стрела убийства — магическое оружие, соз:
An arrow of slaying is a magic weapon meant to slay a particular kind of creature. Some are more focused than others; for example, there are both arrows of dragon slaying and arrows of blue dragon slaying. If a creature belonging to the type, race, or group associated with an arrow of slaying takes damage from the arrow, the creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 6d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.
Once an arrow of slaying deals its extra damage to a creature, it becomes a nonmagical arrow.
Other types of magic ammunition of this kind exist, such as bolts of slaying meant for a crossbow, though arrows are most common.
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/armor.ts.Пока вы носите этот доспех, вы получаете:
While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, and you can understand and speak Abyssal. In addition, the armor's clawed gauntlets turn unarmed strikes with your hands into magic weapons that deal slashing damage, with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls and a damage die of 1d8.
Curse. Once you don this cursed armor, you can't doff it unless you are targeted by the remove curse spell or similar magic. While wearing the armor, you have disadvantage on attack rolls against demons and on saving throws against their spells and special abilities.
Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a black dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued.
While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to acid damage.
Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest black dragon within 30 miles of you. This special action can't be used again until the next dawn.

packages/domain/srd/magic-items/armor.ts.Мифрил — лёгкий и гибкий металл. Мифрило: Mithral is a light, flexible metal. A mithral chain shirt or breastplate can be worn under normal clothes. If the armor normally imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.

This property of the armor can't be used again until the next dawn.

While holding this shield, you have resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks.

Whenever a ranged weapon attack is made against a target within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/armor.ts.Пока вы держите этот щит, вы совершаете: While holding this shield, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks have disadvantage against you.

The oil can cover a Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the etherealness spell for 1 hour.

For 1 hour, the coated item is magical and has a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

The oil can cover a Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of a freedom of movement spell for 8 hours.

packages/domain/srd/magic-items/rings.ts.У этого кольца 3 заряда; каждый день на:
This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells:
Animal friendship (save DC 13)
Fear (save DC 13), targeting only beasts that have an Intelligence of 3 or lower
Speak with animals
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/rings.ts.Пока вы носите это кольцо, вы можете дей:
While wearing this ring, you can speak its command word as an action to summon a particular djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of you. It remains as long as you concentrate (as if concentrating on a spell), to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 hit points. It then returns to its home plane.
While summoned, the djinni is friendly to you and your companions. It obeys any commands you give it, no matter what language you use. If you fail to command it, the djinni defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions.
After the djinni departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies.
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/rings.ts.Это кольцо связано со Стихийным планом В:
This ring is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air.
While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against air elementals, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Air.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.
You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on an air elemental. In addition, when you fall, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling. You can also speak and understand Auran.
If you help slay an air elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You have resistance to lightning damage.
You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: chain lightning (3 charges), gust of wind (2 charges), or wind wall (1 charge).
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/rings.ts.Это кольцо связано со Стихийным планом З:
This ring is linked to the Elemental Plane of Earth.
While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against earth elementals, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Earth.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.
You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on an earth elemental. In addition, you can move in difficult terrain that is composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt as if it were normal terrain. You can also speak and understand Terran.
If you help slay an earth elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You have resistance to acid damage.
You can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were difficult terrain. If you end your turn there, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: stone shape (2 charges), stoneskin (3 charges), or wall of stone (3 charges).
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/rings.ts.Это кольцо связано со Стихийным планом О:

While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against fire elementals, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Fire.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.
You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on a fire elemental. In addition, you have resistance to fire damage. You can also speak and understand Ignan.
If you help slay a fire elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You are immune to fire damage.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: burning hands (1 charge), fireball (2 charges), and wall of fire (3 charges).
packages/domain/srd/magic-items/rings.ts.Это кольцо связано со Стихийным планом В:

If you help slay a water elemental while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:
You can breathe underwater and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: create or destroy water (1 charge), control water (3 charges), ice storm (2 charges), or wall of ice (3 charges).
